== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Ragahn is the leader of the [[Fisher sect]], known as the [[First Fisher]]. He possesses a disheveled appearance similar to a beggar, characterized by stained brown clothing, bare feet, and loose gray hair. He carries a net containing bloody parts from [[dreadbeasts]] and utilizes a rusted Iron{{!}}iron hook as a weapon. As a [[Truegold]], Ragahn has achieved total mastery over the [[Remnant]] within his core, though his [[Goldsign]] is so faint that it is nearly imperceptible to outsiders. He demonstrates significant power, such as the ability to manipulate forces to move people and descend safely from heights. Despite his unkempt look, he is a formidable figure whose Authority{{!}}authority allows him to act with near-total freedom, though he has expressed an intention to intervene in conflicts if they become too hazardous.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Ragahn is a [[sacred artist]] who utilizes a [[Fisher's hook]] constructed from rust-patched Iron{{!}}iron. As a member of the [[Fisher sect]], he has attained the [[Truegold]] stage.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Ragahn is a member of the [[Fisher sect]] who eventually rises to become its leader, known as the [[First Fisher]]. As a [[sacred artist]], he wields a specialized [[Fisher's hook]] constructed from rust-patched Iron{{!}}iron. By the time of his leadership, he has progressed through the ranks to reach the [[Truegold]] stage.}}
